message.content:
This editorial illustration depicts a white background with red and black text and stylized figures. At the top, a red banner contains black text: "Risiko Proyek Mercusuar Tanggul Laut Raksasa H.86" and "Dalang Korupsi Pengadaan Laptop Kementerian Pendidikan H.72". Below, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large red serif letters, with a small "54" logo to the right. Smaller red text underneath reads, "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". On the left, large black text says, "ERICK THOHIR SAMPAI DI SINI".

A large illustration occupies the center. A massive, three-dimensional acronym "BUMN" in shades of blue and teal is tilted diagonally. A large, tan-skinned hand on the right appears to be flicking the top "U" with its index finger. On the far left, a small, caricature-like man in a black suit and blue scarf hangs from the edge of the dark blue "B". He has dark hair, a round face, and his right arm is stretched upward, grasping the letter. At the bottom, text indicates "9-15 JUNI 2025", "RP 60.000", and a barcode with the number "00017".
